source_quote: After single i.v. bolus administration, RTD-1 (SEQ ID NO. 1) displayed a biphasic profile, with a relatively short distribution phase followed by a longer elimination phase with a half-life of 6.05 hours.
source_location: Pharmacokinetics, para [0043] Mouse studies (PDF page 15); Table 1 (pages 15-16)
route_quote: were administered a single 5 mg/kg i.v. bolus injection of RTD-1 (SEQ ID NO. 1) into the lateral tail vein.
notes: Only one mouse dose (5 mg/kg IV bolus, pooled sparse-sampling NCA; Table 1 gives lambda-z 0.114 /h, ln2/0.114 = 6.1 h, consistent). Methods para [0068], PDF page 31. No other mouse dose/route half-life reported (SC 5 and 25 mg/kg cited only as AUC from ref 3). OCR: Table 1 clear; para [0039] sentence on elimination half-life is truncated by OCR.
